Ertugliflozin and benzyl benzoate are both known to interact with the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, indicating a possible mechanism of action through this transporter. The scores from the two paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence highlights a possible pathway where Vatiquinone may influence the activity of IFNAR, which in turn could affect the function of the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm this mechanism.
